# HBS Online

> Harvard Business School's online learning platform offering flexible certificate and credential programs in business fundamentals, leadership, strategy, and emerging technologies through case-study method instruction.

HBS Online provides accessible business education to professionals worldwide through specialized certificate programs (CORe, CLIMB) and individual courses. The platform combines Harvard's rigorous case-method pedagogy with practical skills in areas like data science, AI, marketing, finance, and leadership development.

## Key Topics

- Case Method
- Certificate Programs
- Leadership Development
- Business Fundamentals
- Data Science & AI
- Digital Transformation
- Professional Development
- CLIMB Credential
- CORe Certificate
- Career Advancement
- Machine Learning
- Business Strategy
- Financial Analysis
- Entrepreneurship
- Online Learning

## Core Programs & Credentials

- [Learn Online from the Leaders in Business Education](https://online.hbs.edu): HBS Online homepage showcasing flexible certificate and credential programs
- [Why HBS Online](https://online.hbs.edu/why-hbs-online): Value proposition highlighting HBS Online's case-method and career outcomes
- [About Our Courses & Programs](https://online.hbs.edu/why-hbs-online/about-our-courses-and-programs): Overview of HBS Online courses, programs, and credential offerings
- [Business Essentials](https://online.hbs.edu/subjects/business-essentials): CORe certificate program covering business fundamentals and case-study method
- [Leadership & Management](https://online.hbs.edu/subjects/leadership-management): CLIMB credential program for leadership development and team management

## Subject Areas & Certificates

- [Strategy](https://online.hbs.edu/subjects/strategy): Strategy certificate program using case-method learning for business insight
- [Marketing](https://online.hbs.edu/subjects/marketing): Marketing certificate programs with data-driven strategy and brand positioning
- [Finance & Accounting](https://online.hbs.edu/subjects/finance-accounting): Finance certificate program teaching financial principles and business analysis
- [Entrepreneurship & Innovation](https://online.hbs.edu/subjects/entrepreneurship-innovation): HBS Online entrepreneurship courses teaching business opportunity assessment
- [Digital Transformation & AI](https://online.hbs.edu/subjects/digital-transformation-ai): AI and digital transformation certificates for competitive business skills
- [Business in Society](https://online.hbs.edu/subjects/business-in-society): Courses on corporate purpose and aligning profit with global business challenges

## Featured Courses

- [Data Science and AI for Decision Making](https://online.hbs.edu/courses/data-science-ai-decision-making): Data science course covering machine learning and generative AI applications
- [Strategic Financial Analysis](https://online.hbs.edu/courses/strategic-financial-analysis): Finance course integrating accounting, strategy, and business valuation
- [Dynamic Teaming](https://online.hbs.edu/courses/dynamic-teaming): Leadership course on building agile teams in rapidly changing environments
- [Entrepreneurial Marketing](https://online.hbs.edu/courses/entrepreneurial-marketing): Entrepreneurial marketing course for startups with limited resources
- [Transforming Customer Experiences](https://online.hbs.edu/courses/transforming-customer-experiences): Customer experience course teaching standout service delivery strategies

## Enterprise & Resources

- [Solutions for Organizations](https://online.hbs.edu/organizations): HBS Online corporate training and workforce development solutions
- [Business Insights Blog](https://online.hbs.edu/blog): HBS Online blog hub covering business education and career advancement
